aesthetic: Neue Pressroom — Swiss-editorial system built on warm paper stock with red as typographic alarm signal and press-black for authority; every slide reads like a pulled proof.
chromaticArc: Slides 1–10 anchor on Warm Paper with black type; slides 11–14 introduce Aged Vellum grounds and the first red accent bars; slides 15–17 flip to Press Black section dividers (3 slides total); slides 18–32 return to Warm Paper with red used only as typographic punctuation; slides 33–36 revisit Aged Vellum for a mid-deck tonal rest; slides 37–40 introduce a second Press Black divider sequence; slides 41–44 resolve on Warm Paper, red withdrawn, leaving black-on-white as a closing statement.
gridStrategy: All titles anchor at col 6 per left-margin discipline; row position cycles low (row 24–30), mid (row 14–18), and high (row 4–8) across every three slides so no two consecutive slides share the same vertical placement; body text is always constrained to col 6–42 leaving the right 18 columns as structural whitespace.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on 7 slides (≈15%): pull-quote slides, the two narrative-heavy section intros, and the closing reflection slide — wherever the tone shifts from declarative to reflective

accentStrategy: A 1-column-wide Editorial Red bar (rowSpan 2–4) is placed at col 4 on slides carrying bold statements, acting as a left-gutter alarm; thin Press Black horizontal lines (type: line, span 38, col 6) divide title from body on information-dense slides — together covering roughly 40% of the deck.
